translator_notes: Origin unclear: sounds like a modern composed song but I cannot name an author. 'изгора' read as dawn/sunrise and 'мугра' as morning mist or haze, both my reading.

lines.en: Come out, little dove, to the window,

lines.cyr: песна да ти испеам со другарите.
lines.lat: pesna da ti ispeam so drugarite.
lines.en: so I can sing you a song with my friends.
This song is a love song, a sad song,

lines.cyr: слетај ми на дланките, да ти кажам сè.
lines.lat: sletaj mi na dlankite, da ti kažam sè.
lines.en: fly down to my palms, so I can tell you everything.

lines.cyr: Да ти кажам, дал' ќе веруваш,
lines.lat: Da ti kažam, dal' ḱe veruvaš,
lines.en: Let me tell you, will you believe,
Kate, Katerina, beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: дека си ми сè во животот,
lines.lat: deka si mi sè vo životot,
lines.en: that you are everything to me in my life,
Kate, Katerina, my dawn.

lines.cyr: Дај ми да ги бакнам усните,
lines.lat: Daj mi da gi baknam usnite,
lines.en: Let me kiss your lips,

lines.cyr: душава ми гори по нив, пустите,
lines.lat: dušava mi gori po niv, pustite,
lines.en: my soul burns for them, the wretches,
let me kiss your almond eyes,
Kate, Katerina, blue angels.
Katerina, Katerina,

lines.cyr: тивко и без збор сношти замина.
lines.lat: tivko i bez zbor snošti zamina.
lines.en: quietly and without a word she left last night.
Katerina, Katerina,
pain has torn my heart apart.

lines.cyr: Биди мугра пролетна цвет што радува,
lines.lat: Bidi mugra proletna cvet što raduva,
lines.en: Be the spring morning haze, a flower that gladdens,
be a restless river that cools,

lines.cyr: биди ми гулабице сенка, смири ме,
lines.lat: bidi mi gulabice senka, smiri me,
lines.en: be a shadow for me, little dove, calm me,

lines.cyr: летни ми на градиве да ти кажам сè.
lines.lat: letni mi na gradive da ti kažam sè.
lines.en: fly to my chest so I can tell you everything.
